info.description: Chay theo thu tu. Base URL localhost:8080. Dien adminToken hoac adminPassword trong Variables (gia tri local). Mat khau buyer/instructor duoc sinh ngau nhien trong pre-request. Khong chay tren production. Cac request 37-38 chi hoat dong voi DEV_SIMULATOR.

exec: for (const role of ["buyer","instructor"]) { if(!c.get(role+"Email")) c.set(role+"Email", "postman-"+role+"-"+id+"@example.test"); if(!c.get(role+"Password")) c.set(role+"Password", pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}")+"Aa1!"); }

const d=new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()+10); if(!c.get("startDate")) c.set("startDate",d.toISOString().slice(0,10)); d.setDate(d.getDate()+30); if(!c.get("endDate")) c.set("endDate",d.toISOString().slice(0,10));
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("adminPassword")) { console.log("Set adminToken manually, or adminPassword to login"); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
